outcome: umbilical cord SARS-CoV-2 IgG antibody levels
cohort: 58 pregnant women who delivered at a single university-affiliated tertiary medical center and received the COVID-19 vaccine (BNT162b2 Pfizer).
finding: Maternal SARS-CoV-2 IgG antibody levels in vaccinated pregnant women were positively correlated with their respective concentrations in cord blood sera.
